name: LM339
description: The LM339 packs four independent voltage comparators in one PDIP-14 and runs from a single supply of 2V to 36V (or a split supply of +/-1V to +/-18V). All four outputs are open-collector, so each needs an external pullup and outputs can be wired-OR'd onto a common line. The input common-mode range includes ground, which suits single-supply designs. It is a workhorse for window comparators, level detectors, oscillators, and multi-channel threshold sensing.

typical_application: multi-channel single-supply threshold detection and window comparators with wired-OR outputs onto a shared bus.
gotchas: each open-collector output REQUIRES an external pullup resistor
input common-mode range includes ground but the upper end is limited to VCC - 2V
some manufacturers transpose the channel 1 and 2 names; electrically the pinout is identical
do not put a bypass capacitor between the GND pin and system ground when split supplies are used
